questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Robert: Hello, Tessa. Great to see you. What have you _____ doing lately?
questions.explication: « What have you been doing lately? » : present perfect continuous (have + been + -ing) → been.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Tessa: _____ just started a new job in computer software.
questions.explication: just + participe passé (started), résultat présent → present perfect : I've just started.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Robert: You _____ working for Tuffex Plastics when we last met.
questions.explication: Action en cours au moment passé « when we last met » → past continuous : you were working.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Tessa: That's right. I hadn't _____ working there long before I got fed up.
questions.explication: Durée avant un moment passé (before I got fed up) → past perfect continuous : hadn't been working.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Tessa: _____ realized what a horrible job it would be.
questions.explication: Avant de commencer, elle ne savait pas : antérieur à un moment passé → past perfect négatif : I hadn't realized.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Tessa: But what about you? _____ you found a job?
questions.explication: Question sur la situation actuelle, sans date → present perfect : Have you found a job?

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Robert: Well, six months ago I _____ working for a car hire company,
questions.explication: « six months ago » = moment précis du passé, action en cours à ce moment → past continuous : I was working.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Robert: but then they _____ bankrupt. So I'm out of work now.
questions.explication: Événement ponctuel fini (but then…) → past simple : they went bankrupt.

questions.consigne: Ex. V — Read the conversation. Then look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
Robert: _____ been looking around for another job.
Tessa: Well, I'm sure you'll find one soon.
questions.explication: Action qui dure jusqu'à maintenant → present perfect continuous : I've been looking.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
It was my first day back at work. ~~I was on holiday.~~
_____
questions.explication: Les vacances sont antérieures à ce premier jour de retour (passé) → past perfect : I'd been on holiday.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
I'm quite tired now. ~~I play badminton.~~
_____
questions.explication: Activité récente et prolongée qui explique l'état présent (tired now) → present perfect continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
I had to sit down. ~~I'd been having a shock.~~
_____
questions.explication: Un choc est un événement ponctuel, pas une action qui dure → past perfect simple : I'd had a shock.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
You need a rest. ~~How much have you been working?~~
_____
questions.explication: On demande une durée → How long + present perfect continuous (How much porte sur une quantité).
reponse: How long have you been working?

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
The robbery happened at midday. ~~Lots of people walked along the street outside.~~
_____
questions.explication: Décor, action en cours au moment du vol → past continuous.
reponse: Lots of people were walking along the street outside.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
My sister speaks good English. ~~She is practising her English since last summer.~~
_____
questions.explication: since + point de départ, action qui dure jusqu'à maintenant → present perfect continuous (jamais le présent avec since).
reponse: She's been practising her English since last summer.
She's been practicing her English since last summer.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
At last I have my qualification. ~~I've been passing my exam.~~
_____
questions.explication: Action unique terminée, résultat présent (j'ai mon diplôme) → present perfect simple, pas continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
Michelle looked really sunburnt. ~~She'd lie in the sun for too long.~~
_____
questions.explication: Action qui a duré avant un moment passé et en explique le résultat (looked sunburnt) → past perfect continuous.
reponse: She'd been lying in the sun for too long.
She'd been lying in the sun too long.

questions.consigne: Ex. VI — Write the sentences correctly. (La partie barrée est fausse : réécris-la en entier avec le bon temps.)
questions.enonce:
We got to the coach stop at nine yesterday. ~~But the coach has already gone.~~
_____
questions.explication: Le car est parti avant notre arrivée (passé) → past perfect : had already gone. Pas de present perfect dans un récit au passé.
reponse: But the coach had already gone.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Could you tell me your address?
B: Well, _____ (I / live) in a friend's house at the moment. Luckily **I've found** a place of my own now, but I can't move in until next week.
questions.explication: Situation temporaire (« at the moment ») → present continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Could you tell me your address?
B: Well, **I'm living** in a friend's house at the moment. Luckily _____ (I / find) a place of my own now, but I can't move in until next week.
questions.explication: Résultat présent (j'ai maintenant un logement) → present perfect.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Is this your CD?
B: No, it isn't mine. _____ (I / think) **it belongs** to Peter.
questions.explication: think = opinion → verbe d'état → present simple.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Is this your CD?
B: No, it isn't mine. **I think** _____ (it / belong) to Peter.
questions.explication: belong = verbe d'état → present simple.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Can I borrow your calculator, please?
B: Well, _____ (I / use) it to work out these figures at the moment. **I want** to finish doing them, now that **I've started**.
questions.explication: Action en cours en ce moment / situation temporaire → present continuous (am/is/are + -ing).

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Can I borrow your calculator, please?
B: Well, **I'm using** it to work out these figures at the moment. _____ (I / want) to finish doing them, now that **I've started**.
questions.explication: Verbe d'état (think = opinion, know, like, need, want, hate, understand, belong…) → present simple, pas de -ing.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Can I borrow your calculator, please?
B: Well, **I'm using** it to work out these figures at the moment. **I want** to finish doing them, now that _____ (I / start).
questions.explication: « now that » + résultat présent → present perfect.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Why can't you wash your dirty plates sometimes? _____ (you / leave) them in the sink most of the time.
B: OK, sorry. The last few weeks **I've had** so little time. **I've been rushing** around all the time.
questions.explication: « most of the time » = habitude → present simple.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Why can't you wash your dirty plates sometimes? **You leave** them in the sink most of the time.
B: OK, sorry. The last few weeks _____ (I / have) so little time. **I've been rushing** around all the time.
questions.explication: « the last few weeks » : période qui va jusqu'à maintenant → present perfect.

questions.consigne: Ex. XI — Complete the conversations. Put in the correct form of each verb.
questions.enonce:
A: Why can't you wash your dirty plates sometimes? **You leave** them in the sink most of the time.
B: OK, sorry. The last few weeks **I've had** so little time. _____ (I / rush) around all the time.
questions.explication: Activité répétée qui dure jusqu'à maintenant (« all the time ») → present perfect continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. XII — Write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: I've got my key. I found it when _____ for something else.
questions.explication: Action en cours, interrompue par « I found it » → past continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. XII — Write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: Sorry, I can't stop now. _____ to an important meeting.
questions.explication: Action en cours en ce moment → present continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. XII — Write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: I can't get Tessa on the phone. _____ all afternoon.
questions.explication: Action répétée qui dure jusqu'à maintenant (all afternoon) → present perfect continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. XII — Write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: The bank told me last week there was no money in my account. _____ it all.
questions.explication: Dépenses antérieures au moment où la banque l'a dit (passé) → past perfect.

questions.consigne: Ex. XII — Write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce: There's a new road to the motorway. _____ it yesterday.
questions.explication: ago / yesterday / last… = moment précis du passé → past simple, jamais present perfect.
